visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish that the projected prices occurred, whether the projections are guarantees, who would receive payment, or the full risk disclosures beyond the visible scenario table.

visual_context_notes.observation: The presentation includes OneCoin branding and the phrase "The Fastest Growing Crypto Currency in the world......."

A profile slide titled "Amazing Strategist Who is Dr. Ruja Ignatova?" lists education, business awards, crypto publications, and a mission statement about educating the world on cryptocurrency through the Advanced Learning System.

The growth-potential chart slide includes a visible disclaimer: "the price chart presented above is based solely on predictions - whether these values will be reached depends on commitment and effort by company members."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes paid education packages by linking their purchase to tokens and coins that allegedly generate cryptocurrency and return money to the purchaser. The presentation uses conditional predictions of doubled or quadrupled value, package-linked dollar outcomes, declining coin allocations, and a deadline for a free-gold benefit to encourage immediate purchase, without verifying the projected returns, gold backing, or benefit terms.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is the purchase of packages that provide tokens used to produce cryptocurrency coins, with the presentation linking package purchases and mining output to projected monetary returns. This directly supports paid mining or node returns.

evidence.observation: The speaker says purchased packages include tokens that are needed to produce cryptocurrency coins and associates this with money returning to the purchaser.
evidence.quote: our packages also have free coins and a certain amount in tokens and this is very important. You will need these tokens, you will produce to actually produce cryptocurrency coins, which puts money right back into your pocket.

evidence.observation: The speaker gives a paid package price, token allocation, and a token-to-coin production relationship.
